title: Peripheral artery disease: stage, side and ulcer
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's peripheral artery disease and any related ulcer.
note:
Chief Complaint: Non-healing foot wound.

Vitals: BP 138/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative for fever, chills, or fatigue.
Integumentary: Positive for right foot ulceration.
Musculoskeletal: Negative for joint pain or stiffness.
All other systems reviewed and negative.

HPI:
[Copied Forward from previous visit]: Patient is a 78-year-old male presenting with a chronic wound on the right foot. He reports a history of atherosclerosis and notes that the wound has failed to show significant improvement over the last three months. He denies systemic symptoms or acute increase in pain.

[Today's Update]: The patient returns for a follow-up on the non-healing arterial ulcer located on the top of the right foot. He reports the wound remains stable but continues to drain slightly. He denies any new fever or chills.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg daily
- Atorvastatin 40mg daily
- Aspirin 81mg daily

Exam:
General: Alert and oriented x3. In no acute distress.
Right lower extremity: Atherosclerosis noted. There is a non-healing arterial ulcer on the top of the right foot. The wound bed is granulating with moderate drainage. No signs of systemic infection.

Assessment:
1. Atherosclerosis of the right leg.
2. Non-healing arterial ulcer of the right foot.

Plan:
1. Continue current medications.
2. Wound care: Cleanse with normal saline and apply antimicrobial dressing.
3. Follow up in 2 weeks for wound measurement and progress.

Electronically signed, 
R. Mensah, NP
May 14, 2026
explanations: Atherosclerosis of native arteries of the right leg with ulceration of the foot (HCC 263), plus the ulcer code: I70.235.
I70.23- says to use an additional code for the ulcer's site and severity: L97.519 (other part of right foot, severity not documented).

distractors.why: Ulceration is documented: it is the highest stage (HCC 263).
Use an additional code (L97.-) to identify the ulcer.

hccs.label: Atherosclerosis of Arteries of the Extremities with Ulceration or Gangrene

dropped.label: Chronic Ulcer of Skin/Except Pressure/Not Specified as Through to Bone or Muscle
